name: Cronometer

intro.Privacy: Analytics and tracking calls. They change nothing you see.

summary: Remove the ads from the nutrition tracker and stop its analytics (Firebase, Adjust, Amplitude, Braze tracking calls). Needs a free Cronometer account.

android.note: Cronometer 4.57.2 needs Android 8 (minSdk 26) but ships arm64-v8a libraries only. On the x86_64 emulator with Android 11 the arm64 translation of the Flutter engine is too slow to reach the welcome screen, so CI tests Android 16 (and 17 for a release); try older Android versions on a phone.

checks.screen: Eat smarter\. Live better\.|Already have an account\?
checks.screen_shown: The welcome screen (Eat smarter. Live better.) is showing.
checks.screen_missing: The welcome screen (Eat smarter. Live better.) didn't show within a minute.

versions.phone_test: check that the app starts at all (4.57.4 and newer start through PairIP, which closes a re-signed app), sign in with a free account and look at the diary: the emulator test only starts the app.
